open_hypotheses: Standalone entries with clear triggers are more effective than sub-bullets in compound entries. 47e3a943 (foreignness) tests this against 7ca56b8b's buried FOREIGNNESS MARKERS sub-section. If standalone works, consider extracting other buried sub-rules (AUTHOR-FIRST, AMBIGUOUS TERMS).

Title-level thematic reasoning may be a key capability gap. Task 1107: agent couldn't infer 'Nile Crocodiles React to Crying Babies' = 'animals try to bite speaker.' If f5869cc3 rewrite doesn't fix this, the gap may be fundamental.
Playbook length (12 entries) may contribute to non-compliance. 0.00 pass rate coincides with 10→12 growth, but task difficulty (2 historically unsolved replays) is the more likely cause.
Short absolute imperatives more effective than multi-step procedures. c67e6085 rewritten iter 7 — still untested directly. 47e3a943 uses this format.
Time/budget management remains biggest unaddressed gap. Task 3 (iter 7) timeout with zero trace — no follow-up data yet.
Detail extraction from known documents is a distinct failure mode from search/identification failures. Task 309 shows perfect retrieval + perfect identification can still fail at extraction.
The 0.00 pass rate in iter 8 is likely batch variance: 2/3 tasks are historically unsolved replays (1107 since iter 7, 1243 since iter 4), and task 309 involves a new failure mode.
